about: Hamilton sits at the western end of Lake Ontario, below the Niagara Escarpment in southern Ontario. It is a historic steel city that has diversified into health care, education, and a rebuilding downtown. The harbour, escarpment waterfalls, and older neighbourhoods define its geography. About 570,000 people live in Hamilton.
